1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.StarLocalMetric
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronStarFlatDiskMetric
3 
4 /-! The cofacial-source star development is locally an isometry for
5 the actual intrinsic surface distance at every retained point.
6 This version uses the broader small-polyhedron route results. Where
7 nonoverlap is needed, it is stated explicitly as separation of the charts. -/
8 
9 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
10 
11 open Set
12 
13 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
14   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
15     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
16 
17 include size small_faces
18 
19 /-- Each retained point has an actual surface neighborhood on which all distances are preserved. -/
20 theorem small_develop_locally_isometric {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
21     (separated : charts.KitesSeparated)
22     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val)
23     (b : P.UncutSurface a) :
24     ∃ radius > 0, ∀ c d : P.UncutSurface a,
25       dist (c.val : Space) (b.val : Space) < radius →
26       dist (d.val : Space) (b.val : Space) < radius →
27       dist (charts.develop c.val) (charts.develop d.val) = P.surfaceDist c.val d.val := by
28   have nonvertex : (b.val : Space) ∉ P.vertices := by
29     intro original
30     exact b.property ⟨⟨b.val, original⟩, right_mem_segment ℝ _ _⟩
31   obtain ⟨flat⟩ := P.exists_flat_chart b.val.property nonvertex
32   obtain ⟨ε, ep, contained, inclusion, located, rigid⟩ :=
33     small_develop_isometric_on_small_flat_disk size small_faces charts separated cofacial b flat
34   obtain ⟨radius, positive, near⟩ := flat.exists_coordinate_neighborhood b.val rfl ep
35   refine ⟨radius, positive, ?_⟩
36   intro c d c_near d_near
37   have c_chart := near c.val c_near
38   have d_chart := near d.val d_near
39   let x : Metric.ball flat.origin ε := ⟨flat.coordinates c.val, c_chart.2⟩
40   let y : Metric.ball flat.origin ε := ⟨flat.coordinates d.val, d_chart.2⟩
41   have at_c : inclusion x = c := by
42     apply Subtype.ext
43     exact Subtype.ext ((located x).trans (flat.map_coordinates c_chart.1))
44   have at_d : inclusion y = d := by
45     apply Subtype.ext
46     exact Subtype.ext ((located y).trans (flat.map_coordinates d_chart.1))
47   calc
48     dist (charts.develop c.val) (charts.develop d.val) =
49         dist (charts.develop (inclusion x).val) (charts.develop (inclusion y).val) := by rw [at_c, at_d]
50     _ = dist (x : Plane) (y : Plane) := rigid.dist_eq x y
51     _ = P.surfaceDist c.val d.val := flat.coordinates_distance c_chart.1 d_chart.1
52 
53 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
